Research position overview

IMPRS Intelligent Systems recruits doctoral researchers in Stuttgart and Tübingen. Its programme brings together research in intelligent systems, including AI and robotics, with projects and supervision selected through the graduate school's application process.

Research Areas

  • Artificial intelligence
  • Robotics
  • Intelligent systems

The Max Planck Society operates research institutes and International Max Planck Research Schools in Germany. Doctoral candidates work within a selected institute or partner university, with funding and supervision arranged through the programme or project.
